Name: Ahiezer, Son of Shemaah
Summary: Chief of those who came to David at Ziklag, son of Shemaah the Gibeathite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:3: Chief of those who came to David at Ziklag, son of Shemaah the Gibeathite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ahiezer in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
